name: Puzzlemaster
ability: 1 player is drunk, even if you die. If you guess (once) who it is, learn the Demon player, but guess wrong & get false info.
setup: While preparing the first night, the Storyteller marks one player with the Drunk reminder (usually a Townsfolk; a Minion or Demon only with good reason).
wakes: never (the guess is made at any time, publicly or privately)
interaction: Told: After the guess: the Demon player if correct, otherwise a non-Demon player; never whether the guess was right. Chooses: Once per game, a player guessed to be the drunk one.
drunk_or_poisoned: While the Puzzlemaster is drunk or poisoned the marked player is not drunk, and a guess may give false info.

rulings.text: The marked player stays drunk even after the Puzzlemaster dies.
Guessing a player who is drunk from another source counts as wrong; only the Puzzlemaster's Drunk reminder matters.
The Storyteller never confirms whether the guess was correct; a wrong guess yields a non-Demon player.

test_scenarios.name: Correct guess
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Puzzlemaster; Bob Empath marked Drunk; Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns Carol; Guess used is marked.

test_scenarios.name: Wrong guess
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Puzzlemaster; Bob marked Drunk; Carol Imp; Dave Chef.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice learns a non-Demon player (e.g. Dave).

test_scenarios.name: Drunk elsewhere
test_scenarios.setup: Bob drunk via Puzzlemaster; Erin drunk via Sweetheart.
test_scenarios.expected: Wrong guess: Alice learns a non-Demon player.
